queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Free text searches, one per line ("memory leak nodejs", "pandas merge slow"). Each returns the most relevant questions.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags to sweep, one per line ("playwright", "apify"). Each returns that tag's top questions by votes.

maxPerQuery.title: Questions per query or tag
maxPerQuery.description: How many questions to return for each search or tag (max 100).

includeAnswers.title: Include top answers
includeAnswers.description: Attach the top answers (by votes, up to 5) to each question row. Costs one extra API call per 100 questions.

site.title: Stack Exchange site
site.description: Which Stack Exchange site to search. Default stackoverflow; also works with superuser, serverfault, askubuntu, softwareengineering and any other site slug.

newerThanDays.title: Only questions newer than (days)
newerThanDays.description: Skip questions created more than this many days ago. 0 = no age limit.

apiKey.title: Stack Exchange API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional: your own Stack Exchange app key. Raises the shared daily quota (300 requests/day per IP) to 10,000/day. Get one free at stackapps.com.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
